title: Not impressed
text: Not impressed. The picture looks prettier than the blanket! I bought the butterfly blanket with purple sheets! I’m almost embarrassed to hand it over as a Christmas present, but unfortunately, mostly  everything out there now is poor quality!

product_metadata.title: ENCOFT Butterfly Comforter Set Twin, 3 Piece Purple Pink 3D Butterfly Twin Bedding Sets for Girls, Lightweight Microfiber Kids Bedding with 2 Pillow Shams
features: Twin Comforter Sets: 3 Pieces Set, includes 1 comforter 59" x 79" and 2 matching pillow shams 20" x 26", No fitted sheet.

Butterfly Design: 3D printing technology, vivid rich and vibrant purple butterflies bedding set. The color will not fade after washing, very beautiful. The design of butterfly pattern suits to decorate the girl's bedroom and make it's more sweet.

Material: High quality Microfiber fabric, and filling with Cotton Tencel. What make it special: tencel, different from polyester, is environmental material as soft as cotton and easier to absorb sweat, no shrink.
Great Gift for Kids：Butterfly comforter is not only offer warmth but also a home decoration. Great gifts for girls, kids, teens on Birthday, Opening season, Thanksgiving, Christmas, etc.

Vacuum Packaging: If there is fold on the comforter, please spread the quilt cover flat, then use a steam ironing machine to iron the surface and then dry it in the sun. Or put it into the dryer to tumble on a low heat for 15 minutes, came out so soft.
